title: Hundreds of US flights canceled due to outage
summary: NEW YORK — Hundreds of flights from US east coast airports were canceled or delayed Monday due to a telecommunications line outage caused by a construction mistake, US officials said.…

blocks.text: NEW YORK — Hundreds of flights from US east coast airports were canceled or delayed Monday due to a telecommunications line outage caused by a construction mistake, US officials said.
